thread:
nina: FYI dashboard heatmap lag reappeared at 09:12 after the new routing policy rollout. several tiles block while waiting on metric-aggregator.

omar: saw it too. not bundle-related (no new client deploy). network waterfall shows metric-aggregator returning 202 accepted then long poll until data ready. client blocks rendering.

kevin: digging into infra traces 12: the routing policy concentrated requests to a few nodes that had depleted their local metric cache. those nodes hit quota/gating and enqueued work.

nina: so the client sees long poll, not a 429. interesting. any quick mitigations?

kevin: short-term: (1) change routing to spread across more nodes, (2) lower metrics sampling for canary to reduce cold work, (3) add a client-side optimistic render with skeletons so frames aren't blocked.

anya: i can flip routing distribution back to prefer spread-by-cache affinity. also pushing a canary config to cut metric sampling 5%->0.5%.

ci-bot: Routing policy rollback initiated by @anya. CI checks pass.

omar: after rollback, tile latency dropped from ~900ms to ~260ms on canary. the optimistic skeleton render also helps UX while backend warms.

nina: can we also add a server-side warmup hook: when a node boots, prefill the metric cache for leader shards? avoids cold long-polls.

kevin: good idea. i'll prototype a background warmup task and expose `cache_warm` metric so rollouts can watch it.

anya: follow-ups: ticket for warmup task, add routing-simulation to CI to detect cache concentration, small client PR for skeleton render.

nina: thanks team. root cause: routing-weight change + cache cold starts -> backend queueing -> frontend blocking on long-poll. multilayer fixes planned. resolving for now. :white_check_mark:
